text.title: Pyrenean Mastiff
text.body_text: Pyrenean Mastiff is a mastiff or livestock guardian-type dog that descends from the Great Pyrenees and the Spanish Mastiff. This dog is very fluffy. This dog does not descend from Newfoundland instead it descends from the Great Pyrenees and the Mastin Espanol (AKA Spanish Mastiff).

audio.title: Rilla of Ingleside - Chapter 1 – Glen Notes and Other Matters
audio.description:
Rilla of Ingleside by . Written in 1921, this is the final book in L. M. Montgomery's Anne of Green Gables series. Set during World War I, it shows the courage and endurance of the sisters, mothers and wives (and brothers and fathers) left to tend the home front. The main focus of the book is on Anne and Gilbert’s youngest daughter, Rilla. (Summary by Karen Savage)
